src: Digital literacy base skill (every level)

q: Which one lets you hear sounds?

why: A printer prints and a mouse clicks.

q: Put each shape in the right box: has corners, or no corners.

scr: Four shapes to drag into two boxes
a: With corners: A, C. Without corners: B, D.
why: Checks grouping by one property, a basic classification skill.

q: Which one is different?
qa: أي واحد مختلف؟
scr: Four pictures: apple, banana, car, orange
why: The other three are fruits. A and C are fruits, so they belong.
src: General reasoning, no coding needed

q: How does a flower grow? Put the pictures in order.
qa: كيف تكبر الوردة؟ رتّب الصور.
scr: Three picture cards
why: Checks sequencing of real-life steps.
src: General reasoning, no coding needed

q: Help the rabbit get the carrot. Which arrows work?
qa: ساعد الأرنب ليصل إلى الجزرة. أي الأسهم صحيحة؟
scr: 3x3 grid. Rabbit in the bottom-left square, carrot in the top-right square. Each arrow moves one square.
why: B stops in the middle square. C goes off the grid with 3 steps to the right.
src: General reasoning, no coding needed

q: Get the robot to the star. Do not step on the rock! Which path works?
qa: أوصل الروبوت إلى النجمة، ولا تمشِ على الصخرة! أي طريق صحيح؟
scr: 3x3 grid. Robot in the bottom-left square, star in the top-right square, rock in the middle square. Each arrow moves one square.
why: B and C both pass through the middle square where the rock is.
src: General reasoning, no coding needed

q: The frog jumps 2 squares each time. It starts on 1. Where is it after 3 jumps?
qa: الضفدع يقفز مربعين كل مرة. يبدأ عند 1. أين يكون بعد 3 قفزات؟
scr: A number line from 1 to 10 with the frog on 1
why: 6 forgets that the frog started on square 1. 4 counts one square per jump instead of two.
src: General reasoning, no coding needed

q: The cat walks 2 squares right, then 2 squares up. How many steps is that?
qa: تمشي القطة مربعين إلى اليمين، ثم مربعين إلى الأعلى. كم خطوة مشت؟
scr: A grid with the cat's path drawn
why: 2 counts only one direction. 6 counts an extra step.
src: General reasoning, no coding needed

q: Look at the pattern. What comes next?
qa: انظر إلى النمط. ما التالي؟
scr: Circle, circle, square, circle, circle, square, ?
why: The pattern is two circles then one square, so a circle starts the next group.
src: General reasoning, no coding needed

q: Which one is technology?
qa: أيّها من التكنولوجيا؟
scr: Three pictures
why: Trees and rocks are natural things. People did not make them to do a job.
src: G1 S1 Session 1: A Technological World

q: The game sees you smile, and the cartoon smiles too. What helps the computer see you?
qa: اللعبة تراك وأنت تبتسم، فيبتسم الكرتون معك. ما الذي يساعد الكمبيوتر على رؤيتك؟
scr: A child smiling at a laptop camera, and a smiling character on screen
why: The printer and the speaker only send things out. They cannot see or recognize a face.
src: G1 S2 Sessions 4 and 5: Hello AI, AI and Feelings

q: Which part of the computer shows pictures and words?
qa: أي جزء من الكمبيوتر يعرض الصور والكلمات؟
scr: Pictures of a screen, a mouse and a keyboard
why: The mouse and keyboard are for giving the computer instructions, not for showing things.
src: G1 S1 Sessions 1 and 2

q: Where do we keep our files tidy on a computer?
qa: أين نحفظ ملفاتنا مرتبة على الكمبيوتر؟
scr: A folder icon, a trash icon and a speaker icon
why: The trash is for deleting. A speaker plays sound.
src: G1 S1 Session 3: Exploring the Internet and Files

q: What is the safe way to turn off a computer?
qa: ما الطريقة الآمنة لإيقاف تشغيل الكمبيوتر؟
scr: Three pictures of ways to turn off a computer
why: Pulling the cable or slamming the screen can lose work or damage the computer.
src: G1 S1 Session 2: The Computer and Its Tools
o: Choose Shut down from the menu

q: Which of these helps us talk to a friend who lives far away?
qa: أيّ مما يلي يساعدنا على التحدث مع صديق يعيش بعيدًا؟
scr: Three pictures
why: A spoon and a pillow are not technology for talking.
src: G1 S1 Session 1: A Technological World

q: Type the word you see: robot
qa: اكتب الكلمة التي تراها: robot
scr: The word robot in large letters, with a typing box
why: Checks keyboard skills. The platform can also record typing time.
src: G1 S1 Session 2: The Computer and Its Tools

q: You want the cat to jump when someone clicks on it. Which block starts the code?
qa: تريد أن يقفز القط عندما ينقر أحد عليه. أي كتلة تبدأ الكود؟
scr: Three Sprite Lab event blocks
why: B runs once at the start, not on a click. C runs on a timer.
src: G1 S1 Sessions 7 to 9: Exploring Events, Lots of Sprites

q: You press the right arrow key and the car moves right. What made the car move?
qa: تضغط على مفتاح السهم الأيمن فتتحرك السيارة إلى اليمين. ما الذي جعل السيارة تتحرك؟
scr: A car sprite and a keyboard with the right arrow highlighted
why: Nothing made a sound, and the car moved only when the key was pressed, not after a time.
src: G1 S1 Session 8: Exploring Events 2

q: In Sprite Lab, what is a sprite?
qa: في Sprite Lab، ما هي الشخصية (sprite)؟
scr: A game screen with a cat sprite on a background
why: The background and the screen are where sprites appear, not sprites themselves.
src: G1 S1 Session 5: Meet Sprite Lab!
o: A character or object in your game

q: A game asks your name and remembers it. Where does it keep your name?
qa: اللعبة تسأل عن اسمك وتتذكره. أين تحفظ اسمك؟
scr: A question box with a name typed in
why: Sounds and costumes change how a sprite sounds or looks. They do not store answers.
src: G1 S2 Session 1: Story Time

q: In a hand game, the sprite follows your hand on the camera. What does the AI find?
qa: في لعبة اليد، تتبع الشخصية يدك أمام الكاميرا. ماذا يكتشف الذكاء الاصطناعي؟
scr: A child moving a hand in front of a laptop camera
why: The game uses the camera, so it looks for the hand, not sound or keys.
src: G1 S2 Session 8: Handy Moves

q: Match each computer part to its job.
qa: صِل كل جزء من الكمبيوتر بعمله.
scr: Three parts on the left, three jobs on the right
why: Checks that the child knows what each main part of a computer does.
src: G1 S1: Computer parts

q: Which block makes the cat say Hello?
qa: أي كتلة تجعل القط يقول Hello؟
scr: Three Sprite Lab action blocks
why: B moves the cat and C makes it bigger. Neither makes it talk.
src: G1 S1 Session 6: Sprite Dance Party

q: A coin should disappear when the player touches it. Which block do you use?
qa: يجب أن تختفي العملة عندما يلمسها اللاعب. أي كتلة تستخدم؟
scr: Three Sprite Lab blocks
why: show makes the coin appear. A sound does not make it disappear.
src: G1 S1 Session 10: Touch and Sounds!

q: The score is 2. You catch 3 coins. Each coin adds 1. What is the score now?
qa: النقاط 2. أمسكت 3 عملات، وكل عملة تزيد النقاط 1. كم النقاط الآن؟
scr: Score: 2, with three coins falling
why: 3 ignores the starting score. 6 adds 2 for each coin.
src: G1 S2 Session 2: Variables and Scores

q: Which code makes 4 stars with the fewest blocks?
qa: أي كود يعمل 4 نجوم بأقل عدد من البلوكات؟
scr: Three Sprite Lab programs
why: B works but uses more blocks. C makes only 2 stars.
src: G1 S2 Session 3: Again, and Again
o: make new star (4 blocks in a row)

q: Scene 1 ends and scene 2 starts. What should we do with the scene 1 characters?
qa: المشهد 1 انتهى والمشهد 2 بدأ. ماذا نفعل بشخصيات المشهد 1؟
scr: Two scene cards side by side
why: Old sprites left on screen would mix into the new scene. Size and sound do not clean up the scene.
src: G1 S2 Session 9: Scenes
o: Hide them so they do not appear in scene 2
oa: إخفاؤها حتى لا تظهر في المشهد 2

q: In a game, the coin appears in a different place every time. What makes this happen?
qa: في لعبة، تظهر العملة في مكان مختلف كل مرة. ما الذي يسبب ذلك؟
scr: A coin shown in three different places
why: Sound and costume blocks do not move the coin.
src: G1 S2 Session 7: Move, Catch, and Grow

q: You click one button and all the characters start dancing. What is the message that tells them all called?
qa: تضغط زرًا واحدًا فترقص كل الشخصيات. ما اسم الرسالة التي تخبرهم كلهم؟
why: Costumes and backdrops change how things look. They do not send messages.
src: G1 S2 Session 6: Camera Filters

q: What is an algorithm?
qa: ما هي الخوارزمية؟
why: B and C confuse the idea with things children see on a computer.
src: G2 S1 Session 1 (CMS): What Is an Algorithm
o: Steps in order to solve a problem

q: Which program does the same thing as: move forward, move forward, move forward, move forward?
qa: أي برنامج يفعل الشيء نفسه مثل: تقدّم، تقدّم، تقدّم، تقدّم؟
scr: Three block programs
why: B moves only 2 steps and C only 1. A loop gives the same result with a shorter program.
src: G2 S1 Session 5 (CMS reading material): Loops

q: The bee should go: forward, forward, LEFT, forward. Which block is wrong?
qa: يجب أن تمشي النحلة: للأمام، للأمام، يسارًا، للأمام. أي بلوك خطأ؟
scr: Program: move forward, move forward, turn right, move forward
why: The moves are right, but the turn goes the wrong way. A computer follows the exact steps, so one wrong step changes the result.
src: G2 S1 Sessions 2 and 4 (CMS): Sequence, Patterns

q: Rule: IF the flower has nectar, collect it. ELSE, move forward. This flower has no nectar. What does the bee do?
qa: القاعدة: إذا كان في الزهرة رحيق، اجمعه. وإلا، امشِ للأمام. هذه الزهرة بلا رحيق. ماذا تفعل النحلة؟
scr: A bee next to a flower with no nectar
why: A follows the if part even though the condition is false. C forgets the else part.
src: G2 S1 Sessions 7 and 8 (CMS): Conditions, If Else

q: Which of these is an event?
qa: أيّ مما يلي يُعدّ حدثًا (event)؟
why: An event is something that happens. A color and a word just exist.
src: G2 S1 Session 3 (CMS): Events

q: A condition is a question the computer checks. What kind of answer does it have?
qa: الشرط سؤال يفحصه الكمبيوتر. ما نوع إجابته؟
why: A condition is a yes-or-no question, so its answer can only be true or false.
src: G2 S1 Session 7 (CMS): Conditions

q: When do we use a Repeat Until loop?
qa: متى نستخدم حلقة "كرّر حتى"؟
why: B fits a repeat block with a number. Repeat Until stops when its goal is reached, so it is not forever.
src: G2 S1 Session 6 (CMS): Repeat Until
o: When you know the goal but not how many repeats you need
When you want to repeat exactly 3 times
When you never want the loop to stop
oa: عندما تعرف الهدف لكن لا تعرف عدد مرات التكرار
عندما لا تريد أن تتوقف الحلقة أبدًا

q: How can we teach an AI to tell apples from bananas?
qa: كيف نعلّم الذكاء الاصطناعي أن يفرّق بين التفاح والموز؟
scr: Pictures of apples and bananas
why: Without examples, AI can only guess. It learns from training examples.
src: G2 S1 Session 10 (CMS): Training AI
o: Show it many examples with the right names (training)
Do nothing, because it already knows
oa: نعرض عليه أمثلة كثيرة بأسمائها الصحيحة (التدريب)
لا نفعل شيئًا لأنه يعرف كل شيء

q: What is a variable like?
qa: بماذا يشبه المتغير؟
why: A variable stores a value that can change while the game runs. Pictures and sounds are game assets.
src: G2 S2 Session 3 (CMS): Blow the Balloon
o: A box that remembers information, like the score

q: Which of these uses AI in everyday life?
qa: أيّ مما يلي يستخدم الذكاء الاصطناعي في الحياة اليومية؟
why: AI can recognize spoken words. A pencil and a chair cannot learn or recognize anything.
src: G2 S1 Session 9 (CMS): Artificial Intelligence
o: A phone that understands what you say

q: Why does the order of steps matter in an algorithm?
qa: لماذا يهم ترتيب الخطوات في الخوارزمية؟
why: Putting on shoes before socks shows why order matters.
src: G2 S1 Session 2 (CMS): Humans vs. Computers, Sequence
o: Steps in the wrong order give the wrong result
oa: الخطوات بترتيب خاطئ تعطي نتيجة خاطئة

q: How many steps does the character move?
qa: كم خطوة تتحرك الشخصية؟
scr: repeat 4 times [ move forward ]
why: 1 counts the block, not the repeats. 5 counts one extra step.
src: G2 S1 Session 5 (CMS): Loops

q: In a game, a coin appears in a different place each time you play. What is this called?
qa: في لعبة، تظهر العملة في مكان مختلف كل مرة تلعب. ماذا يُسمّى هذا؟
scr: The same game shown twice with the coin in different places
why: Randomization makes the game different each time. Repeating and sequencing do not change where the coin appears.
src: G2 S2 Session 5 (CMS): Random Fun in Games

q: The robot should walk 3 steps. It only walks 2. What is the bug?
qa: يجب أن يمشي الروبوت 3 خطوات، لكنه مشى خطوتين فقط. أين الخطأ؟
scr: Program: move forward, move forward
why: B and C do not change how many steps the robot takes.
src: G2 S1: Debugging
o: The robot is the wrong color

q: The bee moves forward until it reaches the flower. The flower is 3 squares away. How many moves?
qa: تمشي النحلة للأمام حتى تصل إلى الزهرة. الزهرة على بعد 3 مربعات. كم حركة تحتاج؟
scr: repeat until at flower [ move forward ]
why: Repeat Until stops as soon as the goal is reached. 4 counts one extra step. 1 forgets that the loop repeats.
src: G2 S1 Session 6 (CMS): Repeat Until

q: Forward, right, forward, right, forward, right. Which part repeats?
qa: للأمام، يمين، للأمام، يمين، للأمام، يمين. أي جزء يتكرر؟
scr: Six instruction cards in a row
why: The pattern unit is the smallest part that repeats. B is only half of it, and C never appears in the pattern.
src: G2 S1 Session 4 (CMS): Patterns

q: Which block keeps the clouds moving for the whole game?
qa: أي بلوك يجعل السحاب يتحرك طوال اللعبة؟
scr: Three MakeCode Arcade blocks
why: repeat 2 times stops after two runs. on start runs only once when the game begins.
src: G2 S2 Session 4 (CMS): Forever Moving

q: What is the score at the end?
qa: كم النتيجة في النهاية؟
scr:
set score to 2
repeat 3 times [ change score by 2 ]
why: The score starts at 2 and grows by 2 three times. 6 forgets the starting value. 5 adds 1 each time.
src: G2 S2 Session 3 and S1 Session 5 (CMS)

q: Rule: IF the path is clear, move forward. ELSE, turn left. There is a wall in front of the bee. What does it do?
qa: القاعدة: إذا كان الطريق مفتوحًا، امشِ للأمام. وإلا، استدر يسارًا. أمام النحلة جدار. ماذا تفعل؟
scr: A bee facing a wall
why: The wall makes the condition false, so the else part runs. Nothing in the rule says to stop.
src: G2 S1 Session 8 (CMS): If Else

q: Match each block to what it does.
qa: صِل كل بلوك بما يفعله.
scr: Three blocks on the left, three jobs on the right
why: Checks loops, conditions and events together, the three big ideas of Grade 2.
src: G2 S1: Loops, conditions and events
o: repeat 3 times = Does the same thing 3 times
when clicked = Starts when you click
oa: كرّر 3 مرات = يفعل الشيء نفسه 3 مرات

q: Build the program: the robot must reach the battery. Drag the blocks into the right order.
qa: ابنِ البرنامج: يجب أن يصل الروبوت إلى البطارية. اسحب الكتل بالترتيب الصحيح.
scr: Grid. The robot faces right. The battery is 2 squares to the right, then 1 square up.
a: B, C, A, D (the three move forward blocks can swap places)
why: Scored as correct only if the turn is the third block. Facing right, the robot must turn left to face up.
src: G2 S1 Sessions 2 and 4 (CMS): Sequence, Patterns

q: How many move forward steps happen in this program?
qa: كم خطوة «تقدّم» تحدث في هذا البرنامج؟
scr: repeat 3 times [ move forward, move forward, turn right ]
why: 3 counts one move in each loop instead of two. 9 counts every block, including the turns.
src: G2 S1 Session 5 (CMS): Loops

q: The robot repeats until its energy is 0: jump, then lose 1 energy. Energy starts at 3. How many times does it jump? Type the number.
qa: يكرّر الروبوت حتى تصبح طاقته 0: يقفز ثم يخسر 1 من الطاقة. تبدأ الطاقة من 3. كم مرة يقفز؟ اكتب الرقم.
scr: repeat until energy = 0 [ jump, change energy by -1 ]
why: Common wrong answers: 4 (one jump too many) and 2 (stops one jump early).
src: G2 S1 Session 6 (CMS): Repeat Until

q: The score starts at 0. Each time the player pops a balloon, the score goes up by 2. The player pops 5 balloons. What is the score? Type the number.
qa: تبدأ النتيجة من 0. في كل مرة يفرقع اللاعب بالونًا تزيد النتيجة 2. فرقع اللاعب 5 بالونات. كم النتيجة؟ اكتب الرقم.
scr:
set score to 0
on balloon popped [ change score by 2 ]
why: Common wrong answers: 7 (adds instead of multiplying) and 5 (adds 1 each time).
src: G2 S2 Session 3 (CMS): Blow the Balloon

q: What is the score at the end? Type the number.
qa: كم النتيجة في النهاية؟ اكتب الرقم.
scr:
set score to 0
repeat 4 times [ change score by 5 ]
why: Common wrong answers: 9 (adds 4 and 5) and 5 (runs the loop once).
src: G2 S2 Session 3 and S1 Session 5 (CMS)

q: Build the program: the bee moves forward 3 times using a loop, then gets the nectar.
qa: ابنِ البرنامج: تتقدّم النحلة 3 مرات باستخدام حلقة، ثم تجمع الرحيق.
scr: Three blocks to drag into order. The move block snaps inside the loop.
why: Scored as correct only if fully right. Getting nectar inside the loop would happen 3 times.
src: G2 S1 Session 5 (CMS): Loops

qa: أي زر يحفظ عملك؟
why: Delete removes work and Cut moves it.

q: Which is the best password?
qa: أي كلمة سر هي الأفضل؟
why: Short numbers and names are easy to guess.

q: A pop-up says: "Click here to win a prize!" What should you do?

why: Prize pop-ups are usually tricks.

q: Match each icon to what it does.
qa: صِل كل أيقونة بما تفعله.
why: Checks common icons every app uses.

q: You made a drawing on the computer. How do you keep it for tomorrow?
qa: رسمت رسمة على الكمبيوتر. كيف تحتفظ بها للغد؟
why: B and C lose the drawing.
src: Digital literacy base skill (every level)

q: Mona is taller than Ali. Ali is taller than Sami. Who is the shortest?
qa: منى أطول من علي. علي أطول من سامي. من الأقصر؟
scr: Three children drawn at the same height so the picture gives no clue
why: Mona is the tallest. Ali is in the middle.
src: General reasoning, no coding needed

q: A magic machine makes red shapes big. Other shapes stay the same. Which shapes come out big?
qa: آلة سحرية تكبّر الأشكال الحمراء فقط، والباقي يبقى كما هو. أي الأشكال تخرج كبيرة؟
scr: Four shapes go into the machine: red circle, blue square, red triangle, green circle
why: A checks the shape instead of the color. C ignores the rule. D applies the rule backwards.
src: General reasoning (similar to G2 S1 Session 9: Conditionals)
o: The red circle and the red triangle
The blue square and the green circle

q: Sort these cards from smallest to biggest.
qa: رتّب هذه البطاقات من الأصغر إلى الأكبر.
scr: Four number cards
why: Checks ordering, the idea behind sorting algorithms.
src: General reasoning, no coding needed

q: Today is Monday. What day will it be in 3 days?
qa: اليوم هو الاثنين. ما اليوم الذي سيأتي بعد 3 أيام؟
why: Wednesday counts only 2 days. Friday counts 4.
src: General reasoning, no coding needed

q: Which number does not belong? 2, 4, 7, 8
qa: أي رقم لا ينتمي إلى المجموعة؟ 2، 4، 7، 8
why: 7 is the only odd number. 2 is the smallest and 8 is the biggest, but size is not the rule. 4 fits the even pattern.
src: General reasoning, no coding needed

q: A robot starts facing up. It repeats this 3 times: move forward 2, turn right. Which way is it facing at the end?
qa: يبدأ روبوت وهو متجه إلى الأعلى. يكرّر هذا 3 مرات: تقدّم خطوتين، استدر يمينًا. إلى أي اتجاه سيكون متجهًا في النهاية؟
scr: A robot on a grid, pointing up
why: A forgets the turns. B counts one turn. C counts two turns.
src: General reasoning (similar to G2 S1 Sessions 6 and 7: Loops)

q: Three children stand in a line. Omar is first. Ali is not first. Huda stands right after Ali. Who is last?
qa: يقف ثلاثة أطفال في صف. عمر هو الأول. علي ليس الأول. تقف هدى مباشرة بعد علي. من الأخير؟
why: Omar is first, so Ali is second, and Huda, right after Ali, is third.
